The annual meeting of the [http://www.lojban.org/tiki/The+Logical+Language+Group LLG] has been held by email since 2005, and the membership of the LLG agreed that after 2007, this practice would be continued. Since that time, the mailing list archive has been deemed to satisfy the requirement for minutes. The [http://mail.lojban.org/mailman/private/llg-members/ archive] contains all messages in the llg-members mailing list since September 2011, and is available to members.
